name: Gangway Perdition
geological_features: A single continent-spanning canyon system serving as the planet's only sheltered route between hemispheres
Wind-polished glass deserts on the exposed plateaus
Thermal vents in the canyon floor providing localized warmth
specific_features: Ruins of a failed colonial settlement in the deepest canyon section
description: Gangway Perdition is a medium desert world where the surface plateaus are scoured by winds of such ferocity that nothing can survive on them for long. The planet's single remarkable feature is the Gangway — an enormous canyon system that cuts across the primary continent from coast to dust-sea, its walls high enough to shield the interior from the worst of the surface winds. The canyon floor is warmer and calmer than the plateaus above, heated by thermal vents that keep temperatures tolerable even during the frigid nights.

The plateaus above the Gangway are polished to a glass-like finish by centuries of wind-driven sand, their surfaces reflecting the sky so perfectly that the horizon disappears into a seamless mirror of amber and white. Nothing grows there, nothing moves except the wind itself. The thin atmosphere provides minimal pressure and no protection from radiation, making surface traversal outside the canyon a exercise in calculated risk and diminishing returns.

A colonial venture attempted to establish a settlement in the Gangway's deepest section forty years ago, drawn by the thermal vents and the relative shelter from surface conditions. The colony failed within three years — the canyon's apparent habitability proved deceptive, as seasonal wind pattern shifts funneled plateau storms directly through the Gangway twice per year with devastating force. The ruins remain, half-buried in sand, their prefabricated structures crumpled like paper.

The Gangway retains value as a transit route for surface vehicles crossing between the planet's few points of interest, its sheltered floor the only viable path across the primary continent. Automated weather stations provide storm warnings, and emergency shelters have been installed at regular intervals by the salvage crews who still pick through the colonial ruins. Gangway Perdition serves as a cautionary tale about the difference between shelter and safety.
